newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent forges new highs on short covering.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent forges new highs on short covering.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures forged new highs as forecasts of cold weather in the U.S. Northeast and Mid-West continued to fuel a rally in NYMEX futures.

January Brent, which expires at close of business, surged through $24 a barrel for a brief spell and January gas oil put on around $9 a tonne as traders on both sides of the Atlantic covered short positions.
By 1657 GMT Jan Brent stood 38 cents up at $23.91 after touching a high of $24.07 a barrel.
The February contract stood 63 cents firmer at $23.53, after advancing to $23.62, narrowing the Jan/Feb spread to around 45 cents.
"There not to much behind it, just the forecasts of cold weather," one trader said.
Jan gas oil stood $8.25 a tonne firmer at $222.00, 75 cents off the day's high.
